reviewerWarnings: Basin of Echoes has the highest proportionality risk because radial-map parity, revisitation state, and sequence combinations may exceed the five-to-eight-minute target.
Three Bearings must ensure rejoining branches still create perceptibly different intermediate consequences.
Weather Ledger must provide a discrete accessible alternative to hold-to-observe and ensure timing choices do not collapse into a linear checklist.
originalityWarnings: Weather Ledger uses the low-confidence single-reference optional-media candidate; any later media must be independently authored or licensed and remain optional.
Claims that material will be independently authored are design commitments that M3 cannot independently prove before implementation.
unresolvedQuestions: How many checkpoints preserve ambiguity without making consequence too faint or too explicit?
Whether branch rejoining feels intentional or merely linear in testing.
Which independently authored accent roles remain distinguishable under narrow-screen contrast constraints.
Whether optional wind ambience adds emotional value after the no-audio path is complete.
Whether visitors understand that revisiting and comparing are the intended agency rather than optional sightseeing.
How many stations are enough for pattern recognition within five to eight minutes.
Whether station changes can remain emotionally legible without decorative motion or sound.
Which map-to-list transition best preserves orientation on very narrow screens.
How much difference between response paths is perceptible without turning the experience into a branching checklist.
Whether discrete windows communicate time and consequence without an explicit clock.
How to keep the ledger poetic but understandable with assistive technology and text-only fallback.
Whether optional weather audio supports attention or distracts from reading and pacing.
